page.overview:
Who is Amando?

Amando was a Tilean living in Altdorf and a follower of the magician Jeremias Scrivner.

Originally from Miragliano, he had a particular grudge against the Skaven who had attacked his hometown. He was killed during battles against the Skaven under the command of the Gray Prophet Thanquol, who wanted to contaminate the drinking water of Altdorf with the help of the wormstone, a powerful artifact.
